text: In accordance with the Toronto Parking Authority Board of Directors By-law 1-2021, as amended, the Board determines the place in Toronto, day, and hour of its regular meetings and the schedule of those meetings shall be publicly available by the first meeting of the Board in each calendar year. City Council on July 23 and 24, 2025, City Council considered Item CC32.3 and adopted the meeting schedule for 2026 for City Council and its Committees. The schedule of meetings for the Toronto Parking Authority Board of Directors has been developed to avoid dates, whenever possible, that conflict with the approved City Council schedule; and to avoid days of cultural or religious significance. The following meetings of the Toronto Parking Authority Board of Directors have been scheduled for 2026: Date: Wednesday, March 11, 2026 Time: 9:30 a.m. Location: Committee Room 2, City Hall/Video…
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority received the item for information.
